title: Project staffing dependencies into logistics
goal: Expose organization-safe logistics staffing gaps and ownership counts without moving staffing ownership or protected details into Logistics.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Expose organization-safe logistics staffing gaps and ownership counts without moving staffing ownership or protected details into Logistics.

The projection still carries only shift id, role, schedule, assignment presence, status and a remediation link, constrained by org_id and authorized event ids. No worker contact, medical, dietary or other personnel field crosses into Logistics, so staffing ownership and worker data stay in Work.
